topic: Definition of terms, power absorption, feathering & braking & its advantages.
syllabus_extract: Definition of terms, power absorption, feathering & braking & its advantages.
specific_objectives: 7.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe the various types of propellers, principles of operation and pitch change mechanisms.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of propeller pitch change mechanisms diagrams; Safety: No physical handling of live propellers; Supervision: Instructor monitors diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aircraft propeller?
Define the term 'blade angle' in the context of propeller theory.
List two types of propellers based on pitch change capability.

topics: Fixed pitch vs variable pitch mechanisms
development.content:
Definition of key propeller terms
Principles of power absorption
Fixed pitch vs variable pitch mechanisms

Feathering procedure and mechanics
Propeller braking systems overview
Advantages of feathering and braking

Comparison of power absorption states
Operational scenarios for feathering
Maintenance implications of braking

summary_questions: Explain how feathering reduces drag during engine failure.
Describe the relationship between blade angle and power absorption.
Identify one advantage of using a propeller brake system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing fixed pitch and variable pitch propellers, focusing on their operational advantages, to be discussed in LP 03.
